highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 previews Graphite GPU backend bindings and moves the engine to Skia m152.
highlights_body: This preview adds Graphite bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, backend-neutral async pixel readback, and several memory-leak and performance fixes.

bullets.lead: Skia bumped through m151 and m152
bullets.detail: Merges several rounds of upstream Chrome m151/m152 stability and bug fixes.
Adds bindings for the Graphite GPU backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn.
SKImage and SKSurface gain an async RequestReadPixels API that works across GPU backends.
Adds the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, with Vulkan tests now running on Android and Linux.

bullets.lead: Nano Server font support via FreeType
bullets.detail: SkiaSharp now uses FreeType to provide font support on Nano Server.
Fixes an SKRegion.SpanIterator use-after-free, an SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With* use-after-free, and a CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak on raster creation failure.

bullets.lead: Windows native build no longer pins a specific SDK
bullets.detail: The Windows native build stops pinning a default Windows SDK version, and initializes the MSVC environment once per build.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-based font support for Nano Server.
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Fixed the Windows native build to initialize the MSVC environment once per build.
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added the Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn.

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opens the 4.152.0 line, adding Graphite GPU backend bindings, async pixel readback, the new Vulkan Silk.NET package, and Nano Server font support, alongside several memory-leak and performance fixes.

harfbuzz_summary: No HarfBuzzSharp binding API changes; the solution moved to .slnx format alongside the rest of the repo.
